xFpHookLink_mode.title: Hook mode on/off
xFpHookLink_mode.desc: Show the FunPhysics hooks so one can be clicked and linked to another vehicle

xFpHookLink_click.title: Hook mode: select
xFpHookLink_click.desc: In hook mode, choose the hook or vehicle point under the cursor (does nothing outside hook mode)

xFpHookLink_releaseAll.title: Release hooks
xFpHookLink_releaseAll.desc: Release every hook link on the vehicle you are driving (or all links if it has none)
